personalInfo.title: Personal Information
personalInfo.description: Update your personal details for the application

description.title: What does your business do, and whom does it serve?
description.description: Write in plain language, imagine explaining it to a smart friend who has never heard of it

operatingDuration.title: How long have you been operating?
operatingDuration.description: From the date you started building or selling, not your official registration date.

averageRevenue.title: What is your average revenue?
averageRevenue.description: This helps us match you with the right cohort peers.

fullTimeCommitment.title: Are you working on this business full-time?
fullTimeCommitment.description: There's no wrong answer, we just need to understand your situation to set the right expectations.

challenge.title: What's the most impressive or difficult thing you've done to build this business, and what's the one skill gap holding you back the most right now?
challenge.description: Be specific on both sides. A real story of a challenge you pushed through, plus an honest read on what you don't yet know how to do, tells us far more than a list of achievements, and helps us match you with the right peers.

motivation.title: Why do you want to join this cohort now, what specific outcome would make it worth it for you?
motivation.description: Think about where you want your business to be in 6 months. What needs to be true?

choice.title: Do you have any accessibility needs we should know about?
choice.description: This has no bearing on your acceptance into the program, it only help us to support you.
